title: Photo mode
idea: Photo mode: Framing exposure and capture controls surround a clean preview
audience: People who need to capture scene within a game surface.
worksWellWhen: The game supports deliberate scene capture
avoidWhen: A static image is falsely called real-time gameplay
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic craft layout through its capture scene priority and explicit commitment contract: Capture reports actual file output or failure
navigation: Photo mode keeps the current capture scene context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Framing exposure and capture controls surround a clean preview
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to capture scene; the game supports deliberate scene capture
composition.priority: Capture reports actual file output or failure

imagery.role: Support the actual capture scene context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Hide chrome only with a discoverable return control
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the photo mode structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no capture scene content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Capture reports actual file output or failure
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized capture scene content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Capture reports actual file output or failure
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active capture scene context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
